findings.title: Null-strategy test variants never enable the rolling-updates feature
findings.body: createInitialDeployment() returns early when updateStrategy is null, before setFeatureSpec(...) enables ROLLING_UPDATES. The docs in this same PR say the Operator fails when rolling-updates is not enabled. So the testImageChange-null and testCacheMaxCount-null parameterized cases run without the feature and would fail or test the wrong path, unless the base deployment from getTestKeycloakDeployment already enables it. The feature enablement should happen for every variant, not only the non-null strategy.

findings.title: Enabled features are overwritten rather than appended
findings.body: setEnabledFeatures(List.of(ROLLING_UPDATES)) replaces whatever enabled features the base deployment from getTestKeycloakDeployment already declares. Any feature the shared test base enables is silently dropped for these tests. The list is also immutable, so any later addition to it will throw. Merging with the existing list would be safer.
